JavaScript execution minimized
Third-party scripts audited
Performance budget config file present (budget.json/.lighthouserc/bundlesize config); CI performance check script exists in project
RUM/analytics library detected in codebase (web-vitals/newrelic/datadog-rum import or script tag present)
Responsive images implemented
Lazy loading for below-the-fold images
CSS delivery optimized
Unused CSS removed
Unused JS removed
Total JS bundle size within budget
Third-party scripts audited
No excessive JS bundles
Bundle analysis tool configured (webpack-bundle-analyzer/source-map-explorer); build output size within defined budgets
Webfont files use WOFF2 as primary format with WOFF fallback; @font-face declarations include format() hints matching served file types
CSS files minified in production output; source CSS remains readable in repository; build config includes minification step
JavaScript files minified in production output; source JS remains readable in repository; build config includes minification step
Lighthouse performance score >= 75 on desktop and >= 65 on mobile; measured via Chrome DevTools Lighthouse panel under audits tab

LCP (Largest Contentful Paint) < 2.5s; CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift) < 0.1; INP (Interaction to Next Paint) < 200ms; verify via Chrome DevTools Performance panel recording or Lighthouse Core Web Vitals section

No JavaScript long tasks (> 50ms) blocking the main thread during page load; Total Blocking Time (TBT) within budget; verify via Chrome DevTools Performance panel Main thread flame chart and Lighthouse TBT metric
Time to First Byte (TTFB) < 800ms measured in Chrome DevTools Network panel Timing tab; no excessive DNS lookup or TCP/TLS connection time in waterfall
Lighthouse SEO score >= 90 and Best Practices score >= 90 in Chrome DevTools Lighthouse panel; no critical findings blocking either category
Total page weight within performance budget (< 1MB transferred for initial load); verify via Chrome DevTools Network panel Summary row showing transferred size, resource count, and finish time
Text resources (HTML/CSS/JS) served with gzip or Brotli compression; verify via Content-Encoding response header in Chrome DevTools Network panel Headers tab for each critical resource

Static assets (JS/CSS/images) have long-lived Cache-Control headers (max-age >= 31536000) with content-hash versioning for cache busting; verify via Chrome DevTools Network panel Response Headers; use Disable cache checkbox during audit

All images within size budget; no uncompressed PNG served where WebP/AVIF is available; image display dimensions match intrinsic dimensions (no oversized images scaled via CSS); verify in Chrome DevTools Network panel and Lighthouse image audit
Resources served over HTTP/2 or HTTP/3 protocol; verify via Protocol column in Chrome DevTools Network panel (right-click column headers to enable Protocol column)

JavaScript and CSS coverage on critical pages shows < 50% unused bytes on initial load; verify via Chrome DevTools Coverage panel (Ctrl+Shift+P > Show Coverage); flag unused bytes for lazy loading or removal

FCP (First Contentful Paint) < 1.8s and Speed Index < 3.4s on mobile throttled network; verify via Chrome DevTools Lighthouse panel or Performance panel timing markers; FCP marker visible in Network waterfall as vertical line

No duplicate network requests for the same resource during page load; verify via Chrome DevTools Network panel sorted by Name column; duplicate URL entries indicate missing request deduplication or redundant script imports

Preconnect and dns-prefetch hints present for critical third-party origins; verify via Chrome DevTools Network panel Timing tab that DNS/TCP time is near-zero for hinted origins; missing hints cause visible waterfall stalls

No requests blocked or delayed by Service Worker startup time on repeat visits; Application > Service Workers shows worker Active and not redundant; Network panel shows 'ServiceWorker' in Size column for expected cached resources
